title: VooPoo Vinci PNP-X Replacement Pods 2ml
description: The Voopoo Vinci PnP-X Empty Pod brings versatility and performance to your Vinci E120 kit, offering both Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) and Direct-to-Lung (DTL) options to match your preferred vaping style. Each pod is precision-engineered from durable PCTG and PC materials, ensuring consistent performance and excellent clarity for easy e-liquid monitoring. Built specifically for the Vinci E120 kit, these 2ml pods feature a convenient top-fill system that makes refilling quick and straightforward. The MTL pod variant pairs perfectly with PnP X coils in 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm, and 1.0ohm resistances, creating a satisfying experience ideal for nic salts and 50/50 e-liquids . For those who prefer direct-lung vaping, the DTL version accommodates PnP X coils in 0.15ohm, 0.2ohm, and 0.3ohm resistances, optimised for rich vapour production with high-VG e-liquids . Each pack includes two replacement pods, offering excellent value while ensuring you always have a spare ready. The pods feature a robust magnetic connection and sealed design that maintains consistent performance throughout their lifespan. Please Note: These pods DO NOT come with coils.
